ran: 11 cases on agent files, read from the init row's agents list and, with a dispatch, from the model the subagent request used: unknown fields, no name, no description, a name that differs from the file name, bad values and no closing --- (f1); frontmatter that does not parse cleanly (f2); a user and a project file with one name (n1, n8); two files with one name in one tree (n2 to n4); a .md.bak copy, a .md.bak file alone and a subfolder (n5); nested project folders with and without git, and a parent folder only (n6, n7, n9).
result: Unknown fields and bad values still loaded (f1), and a file loaded under its name field, not its file name. No name, no description and no closing --- did not load. A tab indent, an unterminated quote and a bad list indent did not load (f2), but an unclosed [ and a value with a second colon did, and a repeated name loaded with the last value. The project file beat the user file, also from a project subfolder (n1, n8). Of two same-name files in one tree, the one in folder a won both ways round (n2, n3), and a subfolder file beat the top-level one (n4), so the order is filesystem read order. A .md.bak copy did not load, alone or beside the .md file, and a subfolder file did (n5). With the working directory in project/sub, the closest .claude/agents won with and without git (n6, n7), and the parent's file loaded when sub had none (n9).
method: dashboard/experiments/harness: claude -p in a throwaway HOME, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and project under $TMPDIR, a fake key and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL on 127.0.0.1. fakeapi.py logs the model, output_config.effort and cache_control ttl of each request and answers 400; for agent cases it first streams one Agent tool call. The harness only allows requests to fakeapi.py on 127.0.0.1. Managed settings were not tested, because writing them needs admin rights.
